text_block_list.text:
One day, Curren Chan had an interview with 
an online media outlet as part of her PR 
activities. On the way to the interview—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, you see... today's writer is 
someone who interviewed me before."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Back then, it was as a "Featured 
Umastagrammer," though~...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Big Brother, I want you to make one 
promise. ...Don't stop me, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, I want you to make me one 
promise. ...Please don't stop me, okay?

The true meaning behind her words became 
clear the moment the interview began—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
—So, just between you and me... why did 
you debut?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
You're already super famous on Umastagram, 
but did you want to become even more 
well-known, Curren-san?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, did I get that wrong? People online 
were saying things like, "She just treats 
races like a game~" though.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, truth is you just want to go viral, 
don't you? Like, even if you run and end 
up totally sucking, as long as you're cute 
it'll get people talking anyway."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Talk about being clever—or should I say, 
calculating! All that practice is just a 
staged act to make it look like you're 
trying, right?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Her recent posts are as flashy and sparkly 
as ever. It's no wonder people don't think 
she's taking her running seriously like 
that~.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
How about it? How about leaving it to me 
here and spilling your true feelings? 
It'll give you the viral buzz you love so 
much, Curren-san~

That's way too rude, no matter how you 
look at it. Unable to stay silent, I was 
about to interject when—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Sister.

Curren Chan kept me in check with a 
smile... And then, she finally opened her 
mouth—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You know, this isn't a game! Let me make 
that crystal clear♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren aimed for the races because I 
admired the Umamusume running out there.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's kind of a long story, but... since it 
seems there's a misunderstanding, I'll 
explain everything carefully, okay?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Eh, ah, yes...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, Tracen Academy isn't 
somewhere you can get into just for fun.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Even before Curren transferred in, I saw 
so many girls give up and cry. It's a 
tough, merit-based world.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Even Curren has only just debuted. You 
never know what might happen, and in the 
end, I might not leave behind anything at 
all...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But you know, I have to run. I just have 
to.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: A-And the meaning behind that is...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Because I decided on it myself♪ 'Win the 
race and become the absolute cutest!'

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's why I won't run away by saying 'I 
wasn't serious.' I've decided to make zero 
excuses.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren is giving it her absolute all. I 
want everyone to be there to witness what 
awaits at the very end♪

Curren Chan continued to speak sincerely 
about the sparkle she found in racing, her 
new dream, her current feelings... and her 
vision for the future—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
—Well, I'll send over the article once 
it's done! Stay cute, Curren Chan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, I'll be waiting. Thank you so 
much~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ Looks like we made it through 
safely?
choice_data_list: You were so resolute and cool!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehe... Actually, the last time that writer 
interviewed me, I kinda messed up a 
little.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's embarrassing, so keep this between... 
just the two of us, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
He has that casual vibe, right? Curren was 
just playing along with the mood, but 
before I knew it, I ended up agreeing to 
something completely different from what I 
actually thought.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"I was saying, 'I see, but...' and they 
only clipped the part where I agreed. 
Silly Curren!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Still, it taught me a valuable lesson. An 
ambiguous smile doesn't do any good for 
the other person or yourself.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"So this time, you see, Curren handled it 
with a firm and clear smile♪ Now no one 
will look down on me!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
“Still, he's actually one of the better 
ones. You wouldn't believe how many people 
write articles without even bothering to 
show up for an interview.”

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Besides, she gave us a great opportunity♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
What that person asked about was indeed a 
rumor going around on the internet. Things 
like 'Curren doesn't take racing 
seriously'...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Still, once that article comes out, I'm 
sure things will change at least a little 
bit, don't you think~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
No, things will definitely change. Because 
Curren... spoke from the heart.

Just as Curren Chan said, once the article 
was published, it was shared by countless 
fans, spreading her passion for racing far 
and wide.

As a result, she drew even more attention 
than the rumors suggested... Not only did 
she blow past the bad press, she gained 
new fans. Everything went exactly 
according to her plan...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
'#NewFollowers #NiceToMeetYouAgain 
#CuteCurrenChan #Here #PleaseCheerForMe♪'
